title: Metric Implementation Report
description: DESIGN-stage hard-gate artifact. Output of metric-implementation-auditor. Derived mechanically from compare_metric_impls.py; verdict BLOCK halts the stage. BLOCKs when two conditions use a different metric impl_ref/spacing/postprocess, OR a metric declared in the profile is missing from a condition. Profile-driven: canonical impl_ref comes from the domain profile. R3 A3 (2026-08-07): a cross-condition difference every condition explains via metric_impls[metric].varies_by, fully covered by the caller's studied_variables, is recorded in treatment_variation instead of violations — a declared treatment is not a defect.

missing_metrics.description: Metrics declared in the profile but absent from at least one condition

impl_mismatches.description: Conditions or metrics where impl_ref/spacing/postprocess diverged

treatment_variation.description: R3 A3 (2026-08-07). Cross-condition impl_ref/spacing/postprocess differences that every condition declared via varies_by and that are fully covered by the caller's studied_variables — a declared, in-scope treatment, not a violation. Never contributes to verdict.
